initial_decision.brief_rationale: The verified standardized difference does not establish causal identification. Request archived design record R138-2 to assess whether the causal risk difference is identified.

final_decision.brief_rationale: R138-2 establishes conditional exchangeability, consistency, no interference, and positivity, identifying the effect by standardization over Z. The stratum-specific risk differences are 0.90−0.90=0 and 0.60−0.80=−0.20. Each stratum has population weight 0.5, yielding an average causal risk difference of −0.10.
